page_title: Sqlectron - One single DB client for any relational DB

summary.name: Sqlectron
summary.one_liner: Sqlectron is an open source SQL client available as a desktop GUI app and a terminal interface, supporting multiple relational databases.
keywords: one db client for any relational db
use_cases: querying relational databases from a desktop app
running SQL queries from a terminal
working with multiple database types in one client
lightweight database administration on Linux, Mac or Windows
summary.what_it_does: Sqlectron offers two front ends: SQLECTRON-GUI, a desktop application with a simple interface, and SQLECTRON-TERM, a terminal interface for users who prefer the command line. The project describes itself as a simple and lightweight SQL client with cross database and platform support. The page links to the repository, issues, releases and documentation for both versions. It is an open source project that accepts contributions and feedback. The page does not list which specific database engines are supported.
notable: Two interfaces: desktop GUI and terminal (sqlectron-term)
Open source project that welcomes pull requests
Cross database support in a single client
caveats: Specific supported database engines are not named on the page
